kind: stage-A CrossHead (doc 21, f0 mode), mean of halves A and B
inputs: eU f4[N,128], eV f4[N,128], eW f4[N,128], has f4[N,3] (per-view means of the FM features over the cell active wires; zero and has=0 where none)
